description: Dear Friends and Neighbors, After much prayer, deliberation, and encouragement from friends across eastern North Carolina, I have decided to file to be your Representative in the North Carolina House of Representatives. I am asking for your support in next year’s District 79 Republican primary. I believe the people of our district deserve better results […]
